data.description:
Fun Fit Five is a VR fitness game where you will perform different movements to hit incoming projectiles while you exercise across different themed scenarios in different workouts.

**Start your fitness journey**

- Receive workout recommendations in different categories, based on your own preferences and objectives.
- Explore a growing library of workouts, with new ones being uploaded constantly.
- Find the perfect workout for you with a variety of filters.
- Track your progress with in-depth information and stay connected to your improvement throughout your workout journey!
- Create your own Weekly Goals and raise the bar with customized steps and suggestions.

**Challenge yourself**

- Execute multiple workout movements with our three Workout Types: Punch, Blades & Hit Back.
- Try out our unique Workout Events and have an extra-challenge at selected workouts.
- 360º Experience: Choose the classic Stationary mode or level up with full-circle movement for a more immersive challenge!
- Hit harder to score as many points as you can and get to the top of the leaderboard.

**You in control**

- Explore a variety of unique environments, each featuring custom Hit Equipment. Play any workout in any setting you like!
- Rate your completed workouts and help shape the community rating visible to all players.
- Prefer different settings? No problem! Tailor each workout with customizable options to make it perfect for you.
